cohort: The study participants were male mice pups, some of whom were offspring of dams exposed to prenatal stress, and some received transplanted maternal vaginal microbiota.
finding: The maternal vaginal microbiota partially contribute to and mediate the lasting effects of prenatal stress on gut and hypothalamic gene expression in male mice.
mod_finding: The study's experimental design, using cesarean section delivery to allow for controlled maternal vaginal microbiota transplantation, implicitly highlights the role of vaginal microbiota (naturally acquired during vaginal birth) in mediating the effects of prenatal stress.
